Black—Victini and Reshiram |enva=Bill Tost |java=Kenji Utsumi }} The '''King of the People of the Vale''' is a supporting character who appeared in flashbacks in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. ==History== He lived one thousand years ago in the [[Kingdom of the Vale]], where he was the leader of the People of the Vale. His kingdom was vibrant and prosperous due to his people's skilled, wise use of the [[Dragon Force]] radiating from the earth. However, his sons—[[Heroes of Truth and Ideals|the Hero of Truth and Hero of Ideals]], respectively controlling {{OBP|Reshiram|M14}} and {{OBP|Zekrom|M14}}—began fighting, and the Dragon Force became corrupted and destructive. In order to right this horrible wrong, the King borrowed the power of his friend {{OBP|Victini|M14}} and moved his castle and the People of the Earth to the cliffside where [[Eindoak Town]] would later be founded. He told Victini that should the castle ever be moved again, it will unleash the destructive power of the Dragon Force once more. He died shortly thereafter, before he was able to shut down the Protecting Pillars and therefore trapping Victini in the space around the castle. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |main=Victini (M14) |trainer=King of the People of the Vale |pkmn=Victini |type1=Psychic |type2=Fire |img=Victini M14 story.png |epnum=M14 |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom
Black—Victini and Reshiram |vajp=Nana Mizuki |vaen=Nana Mizuki |desc={{OBP|Victini|M14}} was the King's friend in the Kingdom of the Vale one thousand years ago. The two were close, enough so that Victini was willing to lend the King its power to move the [[Sword of the Vale]] castle to where the corrupted "[[Dragon Force]]" could be stopped.
